sizing_assumptions: Avg active sessions: 600/day (30 concurrent typical daytime)
Baseline QPS: 10 sustained; expected peak QPS: 110 during product digest windows

P95 latency target: <= 300ms for 0-512 token gen; <= 600ms for 512-2048 token gen
Burst tolerance: 90s spikes up to 120 QPS; system should fail over to smaller model variant if capacity constrained
